feature_plot_selection: Top three of 128 features for each focus target: Toluene batch9 and Acetaldehyde batch10, ranked by univariate Wasserstein distance from same-gas Train divided by same-gas Train population SD; feature name breaks ties; diagnostic plots only, no model feature selection.
extreme_rule: abs(z)>3 and >5 using frozen SVM Train scaler; descriptive, not removal.
proximity: Euclidean distance in frozen SVM Train standardized 128-D space; class labels describe neighbors, not a newly trained classifier. No use of diagnostic results for model tuning.
